science.title: Quantum differential holography: A quantum-enhanced computational holographic scheme driven by metasurfaces
science.description: Holography captures both amplitude and phase, but conventional interferometric methods require bulky setups and phase unwrapping. Metasurface-based optical differentiation converts phase into intensity, yet it suffers from amplitude-phase crosstalk. Researchers at Hunan University now propose a quantum differential holography, combining a metasurface with polarization-entangled photon pairs. Nonlocal phase-shifting within the entangled state separates amplitude and phase gradients, enabling full complex-field reconstruction via a Poisson solver. This interferometer-free, phase-unwrapping-free method is validated on various samples, opening new possibilities for bioimaging and quantum information. This research finding is published in the journal PhotoniX.
